title: Sandboxed apply preview and audit timeline for Optimize recommendations
creator: Priya Singh
description: Problem: Users of Optimize need a low-risk way to understand and apply automated batching/caching recommendations. Current preview UI shows a static diff but lacks traffic-aware simulation, immutable snapshots, and a clear operator-level audit trail for who applied changes and why. Goal: Deliver a sandboxed, side-by-side preview + timeline UI that surfaces cost/latency deltas, simulated request-level effects (shadow runs), and a tamper-evident apply history that supports notes and automated rollback triggers.
acceptance_criteria: Preview card: Each recommendation card shows before/after key metrics (estimated cost per 1M tokens, p50/p95 latency, expected token-savings) with clear confidence bands and the primary driver (batching size, cache TTL, kv-cache scope).

Sandbox apply: Clicking 'Run in sandbox' performs a shadow apply against a sampled workload (default 1% traffic) and captures real metrics for a configurable window. Sandbox runs must be labeled and stored as immutable snapshots in the audit timeline.
Diff visualizer: Present a delta timeline view that overlays latency and cost curves for 24/72 hour windows (simulated vs baseline) and supports toggling between absolute and relative views.

Safe apply: The 'Apply' flow requires a safety checklist (target model/version, rollout %, health checks) and an optional automatic rollback policy that triggers on predefined SLO regressions. Apply events are recorded with operator identity, notes, and link to the sandbox snapshot used for approval.

Audit trail: All sandbox runs, applies, and rollbacks are visible as immutable entries in a per-route audit timeline with filters for actor, outcome, and tag; entries include links to raw metrics dashboards and GitHub PRs when relevant.
Operator UX: PM and Eng reviewers can add inline feedback on recommendation cards; reviewers' comments are captured in the audit timeline and must be surfaced in incident postmortems export.
proposed_ui_components: Recommendation card with before/after micro-metrics and confidence pill
Sandbox runner modal with sampling controls and run tag input
Side-by-side diff visualizer (metric overlays + small multiples for top 5 affected routes)
Immutable audit timeline with expand/collapse entries and raw-metrics link
Apply guardrail modal with checklist, rollout slider, and automatic rollback toggle
rollout_plan: MVP behind feature flag: visible to org-admins and Optimize beta testers
Backend: land sandbox sample API + snapshot store (ENG-22011), and add apply event API (ENG-27104)
Design/FE: build card + modal patterns, integrate metric overlays with Console charts
Pilot: run with 3 existing customers on dedicated capacity lanes, collect feedback and safety signals
GA: enable to all accounts with a recommended default sampling of 0.5% and brief rollout docs
